incidents.name: sDAO transfer business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: sDAO's transfer logic rewrites the liquidity pair's own sDAO balance without syncing the reserves, so the attacker skewed the reserve and swapped the imbalance out for the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: sDAO 0x6666625Ab26131B490E7015333F97306F05Bf816 created 2022-06-06T04:03:33Z by 0x6519ec010a10bcd2b88e33b6f60e1491e8302ee3, unrelated to attack sender 0xa1b6d1f23931911ecd1920df49ee7a79cf7b8983; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 13,661.92 USDT left the sDAO/USDT pair 0x333896437125fF680f146f18c8A164Be831C4C71 to the attack contract.
